instance_owner.description: Logical/business-level owner of the GNUmed database instance. No spaces allowed.

backup_dir.description: Directory where local backups are stored.

gm_database.description: Name of the PostgreSQL database to backup.

offsite_backup_host.description: Host reachable via rsync (e.g., via SSH keys) for offsite backups.

offsite_backup_dir.description: Remote directory on OFFSITE_BACKUP_HOST where backups are stored.

max_offsiting_bandwidth.description: Maximum bandwidth in KBytes/second for rsync. Empty for full speed.

offsite_by_crc.description: Method to determine file transfers: 'yes' (CRC, safer) or 'no' (timestamp/size, cheaper).

gm_dbo.description: PostgreSQL user to dump the database as.

gm_host.description: Remote host to dump from. Empty for local.

backup_mask.description: File permissions mask for backup files.

verify_tar.description: Whether to verify the TAR archive. Empty means do not verify.

sig_receiver.description: Email address receiving signed replies from the GNotary server.

gnotary_server.description: Email address of the GNotary server.

gnotary_tan.description: GNotary TAN for signing. Empty disables notarizing.

data_path.description: Path to the GNUmed database data backup script.

database_path.description: Path to the GNUmed database backup script.

zipsign_path.description: Path to the GNUmed backup compression and signing script.
